about.anything_you_add_stays_on: Anything you add stays on this device: your library is stored locally in this browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
about.every_cabinet_represents_somebody_: Every cabinet represents somebody’s careful work: photographing artwork, mapping lamps, measuring reels, dumping ROMs and preserving documentation.
about.fruitulator_lets_you_play_classic: Fruitulator lets you play classic fruit machines on any device with a modern web browser.
about.games_are_not_included_community: Games are not included. Community layouts and games can be found at [Desert Island Fruits]({0}).
about.it_runs_the_original_game: It runs the original game ROMs on emulated hardware and displays them using layouts created by the fruit-machine community.
about.john_recovered_the_fml_layout: John recovered the `.fml` layout decryption scheme. Oasis’s layout decoder and system-specific game configuration maps have also been invaluable references for Fruitulator’s layout and `.gam` handling. Much of what appears on screen here is possible because of that work.
about.mame_has_been_an_important: MAME has been an important reference throughout Fruitulator’s development, particularly for understanding the hardware used by different fruit-machine platforms and the behaviour of devices such as steppers, displays, sound hardware and characterisers.
about.particular_thanks_to_james_wallace: Particular thanks to James Wallace and David Haywood for their work on fruit-machine hardware, and to the many MAME contributors whose research and device implementations have helped document these systems.
about.the_68000_cpu_core_is: The 68000 CPU core is tested instruction by instruction against the SingleStepTests vectors.
about.the_layout_authors_rom_dumpers: The layout authors, ROM dumpers and manual scanners
about.the_ym2413_implementation_is_based: The YM2413 implementation is based on emu2413 and has been checked against it for output accuracy. Its instrument tables also draw on research by andete and die analysis by Nuke.YKT.
